blocks.text: Lightweave compresses the old work of joining light and cloth into a patch a caretaker can unfold. By Era Four, the ordinary name and the practical gesture survive more readily than the explanations behind its stitched pattern.
A folded light-stitched patch. Open it and press the weave flat.
One-shot use: The folded patch opens and presses flat into a broad pad. The game performs the final fade.

18 silver. Infection / Digestion / Parasites severity −2; reaching zero clears the treated condition. Happiness +5; Energy +4; Health +4; Fullness -2. All active recovery timers become 75% of their remaining time. Potion Boost gives +1 to each skill for 5 minutes. Does not reduce Injury, Exhaustion, Stress or Chronic severity.
